info.title: Yardarm.CommandLine
info.description: Command-line tool to generate C# SDKs directly from OpenAPI 3 specifications using the Roslyn compiler.

commands.description: Collect NuGet dependencies to include in MSBuild

options.description:
Output directory or .dll file. Indicate a directory

options.name: --delay-sign

options.name: --nupkg
options.description:
Output directory or .nupkg package file. Indicate a

options.description: Suppress output of .snupkg symbols package file

options.name: --embed-symbols
options.description:
Embed symbols in the primary nupkg. Useful for NuGet
servers that don't support snupkg such as GitHub
Packages. Implies "--no-snupkg".
